summary: The Plane of Water is the elemental dominion of tides and abyssal sovereignty. Its trenches, coral halls, leviathan lairs, and tidal palaces test mortals before they reach the throne.
history: Formed when elemental forces claimed dominion over tides and abyssal depths.
Abyssal Trench became the endless chasm of crushing pressure.
Coral Depths grew into living halls of aquatic guardians.
Leviathan Lair formed as the dominion of colossal sea beasts.
Tidal Palace rose as the royal sanctum of the Water Sovereign.
